- My attempt to collect the result with `write_stdin` failed with `[Resource not found] exec session '...' not found in this runtime`, so there was no captured output to read.

So, to state it plainly:

- Printed text: unknown (not received).
- Exit code: unknown (not received).
- TTY_YES vs TTY_NO: unknown; the answer would depend on stdout being a TTY, and I have no captured line to confirm either way.
- MARKER_7319: not observed in any output I received.

I deliberately did not fabricate "TTY_YES, exit 3" or recommend a retry, since you asked for exactly one run. If you want, I can re-run the same command (e.g., redirecting output to a file and reading it back, so the exit code and printed lines are captured reliably) — just say the word and it will be a fresh, explicitly authorized second attempt.
